description: This file defines interfaces and classes for managing Resource Element (RE) buffers, including read-only, read-write, static, dynamic, and modular buffer implementations, with support for views and external data referencing.

classes.name: re_buffer_dimensions
classes.description: Interface for accessing the dimension sizes of a Resource Element buffer.

classes.name: re_buffer_reader
classes.description: Read-only interface for Resource Element buffers, templated by resource element type.

classes.name: re_buffer_writer
classes.description: Read-write interface for Resource Element buffers, templated by resource element type.

classes.name: re_buffer_reader_view
classes.description: Provides a read-only view into a subset of REs across slices.

classes.name: re_buffer_writer_view
classes.description: Provides a read-write view into a subset of REs across slices.

classes.name: dynamic_re_buffer
classes.description: Dynamic implementation of RE buffer with resizable tensor storage.

classes.name: static_re_buffer
classes.description: Static implementation of RE buffer with fixed maximum sizes.

classes.name: modular_re_buffer_reader
classes.description: Reader that references external contiguous RE blocks per slice.

classes.name: modular_re_buffer
classes.description: Writer and reader that reference external contiguous RE blocks per slice, with flexible sizing.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to specified number of slices and resource elements.

methods.name: get_slice
methods.description: Returns a span view of a specific slice, either mutable or const.

methods.name: set_slice
methods.description: Sets the view for a specific slice in modular buffers.
